title: PR #100 blocker: validate explicit actingCharacterId is a PC
description: Explicit RunTurnInput.actingCharacterId could still name a non-PC (companion/hireling) because resolveCharacterId did not validate role. Add a central resolveActingCharacterId (existence + role='pc' -> CharacterResolutionError) and route all acting-character paths (readStateSnapshot, assembleContext, runTurn trace + ToolContext) through it.
close_reason: Added resolveActingCharacterId (existence + role='pc' -> CharacterResolutionError); routed readStateSnapshot/assembleContext and runTurn (validate at top of SAVEPOINT, set concrete id on ToolContext, record on trace) through it. Non-PC actingCharacterId -> ok:false before model call, no trace, no mutations. Tool character-arg targeting unaffected. 5 new tests; full suite 778 passed/3 skipped, biome+typecheck clean. Pushed 5d46ef2.
